title: SoarLog PDF template, format version 1
description: A logbook PDF template for SoarLog. See docs/PdfTemplates.md. The app ignores keys it does not know; this schema flags them to catch misspellings, apart from $schema and keys starting with _.

format.description: Always soarlog-pdf-template. The older soarlogs-pdf-template still loads.

version.description: Template format version. The app refuses a version above 1.

name.description: Shown in the app's template list. Importing a template with the same name replaces the earlier one.

font_size.description: Font size in points for the whole page.

rows_per_page.description: Flight rows on each page, not counting the three totals rows.

size.description: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A5 (148 x 210 mm), LETTER (215.9 x 279.4 mm) or CUSTOM with width_mm and height_mm. The app accepts any case.

orientation.description: Decides which side is longer. The app accepts any case.

margins.description: Millimetres. Left and right together must be less than the page width, top and bottom less than its height.

title.description: Printed at the top left of each flight page. Left out: the app's "Pilot logbook" in the pilot's language. Empty: no title.

show_pilot.description: Print the pilot's name and numbers from the profile at the top right.

labels.description: The totals rows' labels. Left out: the app's own words in the pilot's language.

field.description: What the column prints. launch_time and landing_time appear only with the Record launch and landing times setting, landing_place only with Record landing place. gap is unruled space with no heading.

width.description: Relative width; the columns share the space between the margins in proportion.

title.description: Heading lines, top to bottom. Left out: the app's heading for the field. Empty list: no heading.

align.description: Any other value is treated as start.

roles.description: For a time column: the roles whose duration goes here. At least one.

instruction.description: For a time column: when Instructor and Coach time also goes here. when_pic and when_not_pic follow the setting that counts instruction as PIC time.

split_hm.description: For duration and time columns: separate Hrs and Min sub-columns while hours show as H:MM.

total.description: Whether the totals rows add the column up. Defaults to true for duration and time columns; other columns have nothing to add.
